top_categories.workout_context: 11,483ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
93ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Marcha Cicloturista Quebrantahuesos, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
At mile 60 of 123, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Marcha Cicloturista Quebrantahuesos' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
11,483ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Marcha Cicloturista Quebrantahuesos. Train it until it feels boring.

Road-specific control matters at Marcha Cicloturista Quebrantahuesos. Practice on paved Pyrenean mountain passes: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 123 miles.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 123 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Low-cadence force work supports 11,483ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved Pyrenean mountain passes can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 11,483ft of climbing on paved Pyrenean mountain passes does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Marcha Cicloturista Quebrantahuesos’s 123 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Marcha Cicloturista Quebrantahuesos. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 123 miles of paved pyrenean mountain passes in Sabinanigo, Huesca, Spain.
